_comment: Single source of truth for execution mode and signal thresholds. paper_mode: true = orders go to paper_positions, false = real MT5 order_send. execution_path: which process is allowed to consume the signals table ('order_router' or 'klda_engine') — the other refuses to start.
_broker_time_comment: Broker server time. rule 'ny_close' = America/New_York + 7h (UTC+2 in northern winter, UTC+3 in summer — Pepperstone's New-York-close convention). Falls back to utc_offset_hours if zoneinfo/tzdata is unavailable. Verify with monitoring/hourly_health_check.py --report (compares against MT5 tick time).
_intraday_comment: Broker-time HH:MM. Rollover/swap is charged at 00:00 broker time. The order router takes no new entries at/after no_new_entries_after; the reconciler closes every open position at/after close_all_at, and any position opened on an earlier broker day.

default._exit_comment: Paper/live exit geometry, in % of entry. MUST match the backtest that produced the symbol's stats: database/backtest_5metric.py uses TARGET_PROFIT=0.005 (0.5%) and STOP_LOSS=0.01 (1.0%).

SpotCrude._comment: Backtested 2026-07-17 on 14.6M ticks (Mar-Jul 2026): 243 trades, 58.4% win rate, p=0.005 vs 50% null — but NET NEGATIVE (-0.30%, PF 0.70) because the 0.5%TP/1.0%SL geometry needs 66.7% to break even. NOT validated for live use; kept for PAPER forward-testing only. Re-test with symmetric or 2:1 reward/risk TP/SL before trusting.
